hooks.command: CMD=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git.*commit' || exit 0; SW_FILE="/home/user/reseguide-la-cala-de-mijas/sw.js"; [ -f "$SW_FILE" ] || exit 0; CURRENT=$(sed -n "s/.*la-cala-v\([0-9]*\).*/\1/p" "$SW_FILE" | head -1); [ -n "$CURRENT" ] || exit 0; NEXT=$((CURRENT + 1)); sed -i "s/la-cala-v${CURRENT}/la-cala-v${NEXT}/" "$SW_FILE"; git -C "/home/user/reseguide-la-cala-de-mijas" add "$SW_FILE"
